reason: Radix partitioning preserves membership. Since eval combines terms with OR, membership alone suffices for eval_sort; no stability or adequate-bit-width assumption is needed for equality.
Merging adjacent equal-displacement terms preserves evaluation by AND distributing over mask OR. Full coalescing is a performance property, not a soundness premise.
Each original one-bit mask at indexi extracts exactly sourcep[i], using the same correct two-direction shift arithmetic as Masked.fast; explicit high-bit tail is retained.
fast_eq requires only list length and is valid for arbitrary bits, coordinate values, and high input bits.
Check delegates to the audited Radix.Check after proving evaluator equality; packedCheck and run transport retain the same generator/reference bounds and Full.Good premises.
scope: Generic evaluator/checker/run-transport soundness; concrete generator and full table closure checks remain separate.
